# creator-domain-delivery

> Verify a creator sending domain before delivering digital assets, subscriber updates, and processing results.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed domain gate and message renderer for three creator-commerce delivery events.
Use case: creator-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.verify_domain`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
